spans.s:
mfn. (-ल्पः-ल्पा-ल्पं)
1 Little, small.
2 Inferior, low.
E.
अल to be able, &c. प affix or with कन् added अल्पक.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Small, minute.
E.
अल्प and कन् added.

f. (-शी)
The root of sweet flag.
E.
अल्प small, and केशी having filaments, &c.

n. (न्धं)
The red lotus.
E.
अल्प, and गन्ध smell.

mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं)
Ignorant, shallow, superficial.
E.
अल्प and ज्ञ who knows.

mfn. (-नुः-नुः-नु)
Small, short, thing, pigmy, having a little body.
E.
अल्प, and तनु the body.

f. (-ता)
1 Smallness, minuteness.
2 Inferiority, insignificance.
E.
अल्प and तल् affix, or with त्व, अल्पत्वं.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Defective in presents, (any ceremony, &c.)
E.
अल्प, and दक्षिणा gift to Brahmans.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Of little wealth, not affluent.
E.
अल्प, and घन wealth.

mfn. (-धीः-धीः-धि)
Ignorant, foolish, of little sense.
E.
अल्प, and धी understanding.

m. (-त्रः)
A species of the Tulasi.
E.
अल्प, and पत्र a leaf.

n. (-द्मं)
The red lotus.
E.
अल्प small, and पद्म lotus.

mfn. (-वः-वा-वं)
Insignificant, of little weight or consequence.
E.
अल्प, and प्रभाव authority.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
1 Of little authority.
2 Of little weight or measure.
E.
अल्प and प्रमाण authority, &c.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
1 Credulous, resting on little evidence.
2 Of little weight or authority.
3 Of short measure.
m. (-कः)
Common cucumber, (Cucumis sativus.)
E.
अल्प, and प्रमाण authority, &c. कन् added.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Feeble, of little strength.
E.
अल्प, and वल strength.

m. (-धः-धा-धं)
Causing little annoyance or inconvenience.
E.
अल्प, and बाधा pain.

mfn. (-द्धिः-द्धिः-द्धि)
Ignorant, silly, unwise.
E.
अल्प, बुद्धि understanding.

n. (-त्रं)
1 A little, a little only.
2 A short time, a few moments.
E.
अल्प, and मात्र only.

m. (-षः)
A kind of amaranth, (Amaranthus polygamus.)
E.
अल्प, मृष to hurt, and इमच् aff.

mfn. (-र्त्तिः-र्त्तिः-र्त्ति)
Small, diminutive.
f. (-र्त्तिः)
A small figure or object.
E.
अल्प, and मूर्त्ति form.

mfn. (-धाः-धाः-धः)
Ignorant, silly, of little understanding.
E.
अल्प, and मेधस् apprehension.

mfn. (-याः-याः-यः)
Young, of few years.
E.
अल्प, and वयस् life.

mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि)
Taciturn: also अल्पभाषिन्.
E.
अल्प and वादिन् or भाषिन् who speaks.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Meaning or directing a little.
E.
अल्प, and विषय object.

mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं)
Ill taught, uneducated, ignorant.
E.
अल्प and विद्या knowledge.

mfn. (-क्तिः-क्तिः-क्ति)
Weak, feeble.
E.
अल्प, and शक्ति power.

ind.
1 A little.
2 To a few.
E.
अल्प and शसि aff.

n. (-रः)
A basin, a small pond, one which is shallow or dry in the hot season.
E.
अल्प, and सरस् a pool.

mfn. (-क्षी-क्षिणी-क्षि^1)
Contented, satisfied with little.
E.
अल्प, and आकाङ्क्षिन् who desires.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20161210. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/323, batch 306. note: nom. sgn. of 'xin' is `xI`.

mfn. (-युः-युः-युः)
1 Short lived.
2 Young, of few years.
m. (-युः)
A goat.
E.
अल्प, and आयस् life.

mfn. (-ल्पः-ल्पा-ल्पं)
1 Very little, minute.
2 Grandual, little at a time.
E.
अल्प repeated.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Moderate, abstemious.
m. (-रः)
Moderation, abstinence.
E.
अल्प, and आहार food.

mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि)
Abstemious, moderate.
E.
अल्प, and आहारिन् who feeds.

mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं)
Least, smallest, very small.
E.
अल्प, and इष्ठच् affix of the superlative.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Reduced, comminuted, made little or few.
E.
अल्प and कृत with च्चि inserted.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Reduced, diminished, become little or few.
E.
अल्प, and भूत become, च्चि inserted.

mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः)
Very small.
E.
अल्प and ईयसुन् affix. Also अल्पिष्ठ.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Defective, not quite finished, not wholly entire.
E.
अल्प a little, ऊन less.
